paragraphs: Elation Systems sells labor compliance software to government agencies, non-profits and private organizations. Its core product automates the tracking, monitoring and enforcement of federal Davis-Bacon and local prevailing wage projects.

Certified payroll data collection and prevailing wage certifications are processed automatically, which the company says spares contractors and subcontractors any administrative burden. The same module handles electronic fringe benefits statement reporting. A separate component automates reporting and monitoring for the business utilization programs of federal, state and local municipalities, covering DBE, MWBE and SBE certifications. Another module gives clients a secure, web-based and electronic Section 3 reporting and monitoring process. An OCIP and CCIP component automates on-site payroll reporting and monitoring tied to workers' compensation insurance on applicable projects.

The company says it launched the first SaaS-based Davis-Bacon, labor and contract compliance management system more than ten years ago. It describes support staff with 15 or more years of experience in the industries it now assists. Alongside agencies, the site points to support for the contractors and subcontractor companies doing the building.

quote.text: Whether you’re a government agency, a non-profit, or a private organization, we have the tools you need to fulfill your labor compliance requirements.
